correctness.rationale: Two updates returning to the same configuration imply the two-round firing counts lie in the kernel of the connected cycle Laplacian, hence constant 0,1,2. Only one firing per vertex generates primitive two-cycles. Direct inequality table forces initial site chips into 0..3 and forbids monochromatic firing triples. Equal-phase edges form cyclic matchings with r≡n mod2 and two phase words per matching, giving each weight 2z^(n+r)(1+z)^(n-2r). The cycle matching transfer gives the two quadratic roots plus (-z)^n+(-z²)^n. Evaluating z=1 and reciprocal symmetry yields Pell total/mean; dominant positive root analytic cumulants give variance sqrt(2)/8 and Gaussian limit. Independently enumerated direct chip updates on all 4^n states for n=3..6 and found correct supports/totals 12,36,80,200. The infinite theorem is established algebraically, not by finite enumeration.
